Tara Singh: Quick design check: we keep getting noisy flips between variants when cost+latency delta is tiny. Need clearer arbitration rules and a stable fallback for affinity-pinned routes.
Ben Ortiz: Saw two customer incidents where soft-affinity toggled every 30s causing cache churn. We should add hysteresis and a deterministic tie-break.
Ilya Smirnov: Proposal: two-layer decision: (1) selector applies hard constraints (availability, tenant SLA, hard affinity), (2) scorer ranks remaining candidates with rounded scores + tenant-budget penalty + quality bias. Final tie-break: stable route_id hash.
Priya Patel: For soft affinity, add an "affinity_threshold" (0-1). If preferred variant score >= other_score - affinity_threshold => keep preferred. Otherwise allow fallback. That avoids flip-flopping on tiny noise.
Tara Singh: Good. Also add a pinned-variant watch: if hard-pinned variant's quality drops > delta for 10m, emit `variant-degradation` alert and degrade to soft mode automatically.
Ben Ortiz: Telemetry: emit `selector.debug` with compact fields: candidates[], rounded_scores[], chosen, why. Don't include full payloads. 
Ilya Smirnov: Perf note: make scoring O(k) with k=fanout. Use precomputed tenant budget penalty in shared cache to avoid per-request DB calls.
Priya Patel: Linter: add rule rejecting opaque affinity annotations without `affinity_threshold`. CI should flag missing thresholds.
Tara Singh: Action items: Ilya to implement affinity_threshold and stable hash tie-break. Ben to add telemetry event. Priya to update linter. We'll iterate next week. :thumbsup:
